findings.finding: सूचना ख़ारिज करें: sibling “Dismiss … notice” labels (ui.browser.browser_passkey_notice.dismiss, ui.browser.browser_file_transfer_row.dismiss_download_notice/_upload_notice, ui.common.updates.update_quiet_indicator.dismiss_update_notice, ui.settings.configuration…dismiss_this_notice) all use हटाएँ (पासकी सूचना हटाएँ, …); ख़ारिज matches this band's prompt_dismiss and ui.common.actions.dismiss. Accessible name only. Optional: सूचना हटाएँ. No change.
Button name अनुमति दें is unquoted (every arm); “अनुमति दें” would read clearer. Same call as round-1 HI-N3. No change.

सिस्टम सेटिंग्ज़ › गोपनीयता और सुरक्षा equals the round-1-corrected media_permission hint (Apple hi Mac help, HI-M1); ऐक्सेस matches media_permission.system_blocked; nukta kept (माइक्रोफ़ोन, ख़ारिज, सेटिंग्ज़); हैं agrees with the plural other arm.

Round-2 remediation (748f4c83caf) made blocked_hint a devices select, resolving the a2 source observation (“them” for one device); the component now passes devices (browser-media-permission-prompt.tsx:152). इसे for one device, इन्हें for both — correct.

The other 8 keys are byte-identical to the values audited as mp1843-a2-hi at 99d69f364e3 (JSON key-by-key compare of git show 99d69f364e3: vs 748f4c83caf:; only blocked_hint differs in en, context and this locale); a2 verdicts on them are carried, re-run mechanically here.
